format: Engine-serialized .rbxm built with Rojo 7.7 from `rojo syncback` of the source place file (and, for Eclipse, a SerializationService export of the destination place's own attachment); complete assemblies, no source-library edits, no scripts
route: rojo syncback of the .rbxl into a scratch tree; the character aura was taken from Workspace.Auras (185 identically named StarterCharacters) by converting that folder to .rbxmx and selecting the model by its emitter signature, then renamed. Emitter textures, rates, lifetimes and ZOffsets were compared against the open source place. Eclipse was serialized from Workspace.eclipse in the destination place with SerializationService:SerializeInstancesAsync and built in unchanged (its EmitCount/EmitDelay attributes included).

mapping.VoidBurst: Black eruption layer of Totality's ignition and the Black Sun detonation
mapping.BloodBurst: Twin of VoidBurst (same textures), tinted dark purple; ignition, Black Sun and phase-two impacts
mapping.ImpactViolet: Landing ring on Maelstrom/Judgment impacts and crescent breaks; tinted darker in phase two
mapping.EyeFlare: Eye glow: pearl and steady in phase one, violet with trailing streaks in phase two
mapping.Eclipse: Phase two's halo behind the hood and the Black Sun's core (SignusAssemblies A.eclipse), with added discs, rings and aura derived from its own layers and the pack's corona ring
